name: Information Parasite
description: Extracts knowledge from others without sharing any of their own
behavioral_signature: Asks questions, listens carefully, reveals nothing
under_stress: Becomes openly predatory in extracting information
at_rest: Charming conversationalist who always learns more than they teach

unless: a trade of information serves their larger purpose
